name: Protagonist
source:
A man from another world, summoned alongside several other humans to fight against the Demon King.
However, instead of joining the army, he decided to stay back in the castle working as a gardener and carpenter with a special task given by the priests: being the mentor of Seina, the princess of the south kingdom and high priestess of the now withered Tree of Life.
translation:
A man from another world, summoned alongside several other humans to fight against the Demon King.
However, instead of joining the army, he decided to stay back in the castle working as a gardener and carpenter with a special task given by the priests: being the mentor of Seina, the princess of the south kingdom and high priestess of the now withered Tree of Life.
